translation_snapshot.source: These once brilliant voratun gauntlets appear heavily decayed. Originally used in the spellhunt, they were often used to destroy arcane artifacts, ridding the world of their influence.
translation_snapshot.target: 这副曾经辉煌的沃瑞钽臂铠如今已严重朽坏。它最初在魔法狩猎中使用，常被用于摧毁奥术类装备，以消除它们对世界的影响。

translation_snapshot.source: This heavy torque appears to draw nearby matter towards it.
translation_snapshot.target: 这副沉重的项圈似乎会把附近的物体吸向自己。

translation_snapshot.source: %s's %s lashes out in a flaming arc, intensifying the burning of %s enemies!
translation_snapshot.target: %s的%s划出一道烈焰弧线，加剧了%s敌人身上的燃烧！

translation_snapshot.source: Each step you take leaves a burning trail behind you lasting 5 turns that deals %d fire damage (based on Spellpower) to foes who enter it.
translation_snapshot.target: 你每踏出一步会在脚下留下一条持续5回合的燃烧痕迹，对进入其中的敌人造成 %d 火焰伤害（基于法术强度）。
